#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?target path required}"

TomlQuote() {
  local value="${1-}"
  value=${value//\\/\\\\}
  value=${value//\"/\\\"}
  value=${value//$'\r'/\\r}
  value=${value//$'\n'/\\n}
  value=${value//$'\t'/\\t}
  printf '"%s"' "$value"
}

ParseBackendMap() {
  BACKEND_LINES=""
  BACKEND_IDS=""
  local raw entry id endpoint host port
  IFS=';' read -ra entries <<< "${NP_SERVERS:-hub=127.0.0.1:42421}"
  for raw in "${entries[@]}"; do
    entry="$(printf '%s' "$raw" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//')"
    [ -z "$entry" ] && continue
    [[ "$entry" == *=* ]] || { echo "Malformed backend entry '$entry'; expected id=host:port" >&2; return 1; }
    id="${entry%%=*}"; endpoint="${entry#*=}"
    id="$(printf '%s' "$id" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//')"
    endpoint="$(printf '%s' "$endpoint" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//')"
    [[ "$id" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$ ]] || { echo "Invalid backend ID '$id'" >&2; return 1; }
    case ",$BACKEND_IDS," in *",$id,"*) echo "Duplicate backend ID '$id'" >&2; return 1;; esac
    if [[ "$endpoint" =~ ^(\[[^]]+\]|[^:[:space:]]+):([0-9]+)$ ]]; then port="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"; else echo "Invalid backend endpoint '$endpoint'" >&2; return 1; fi
    (( port >= 1 && port <= 65535 )) || { echo "Backend port is outside 1-65535 in '$endpoint'" >&2; return 1; }
    BACKEND_IDS="${BACKEND_IDS:+$BACKEND_IDS,}$id"
    BACKEND_LINES+="$(TomlQuote "$id") = $(TomlQuote "$endpoint")"$'\n'
  done
  [ -n "$BACKEND_IDS" ] || { echo 'At least one backend is required' >&2; return 1; }
}

ParseIdList() {
  local value="$1" allow_empty="$2" result="" raw id
  IFS=',' read -ra ids <<< "$value"
  for raw in "${ids[@]}"; do
    id="$(printf '%s' "$raw" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//')"
    [ -z "$id" ] && continue
    case ",$BACKEND_IDS," in *",$id,"*) ;; *) echo "Unknown backend ID '$id'" >&2; return 1;; esac
    case ",$result," in *",$id,"*) ;; *) result="${result:+$result,}$id";; esac
  done
  if [ "$allow_empty" != true ] && [ -z "$result" ]; then echo 'At least one backend ID is required' >&2; return 1; fi
  printf '%s' "$result"
}

ReadExistingSecret() {
  local path="$1" mode="$2" key
  [ "$mode" = embedded ] && key=embedded_shared_secret || key=shared_secret
  [ -f "$path" ] || return 0
  sed -n "s/^[[:space:]]*${key}[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*\"\([0-9A-Fa-f]*\)\"[[:space:]]*$/\1/p" "$path" | head -n 1
}

NewRandomSecret() { od -An -N32 -tx1 /dev/urandom | tr -d ' \n'; }

ResolveSecret() {
  local panel="$1" existing="$2" mode="$3" lower
  panel="$(printf '%s' "$panel" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//')"
  lower="$(printf '%s' "$panel" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
  case "$lower" in change-me*|paste*secret*|shared-secret|shared_secret|"shared secret"|your-secret|your_secret|"your secret"|replace-me*) echo 'The shared secret is a documented placeholder, not a usable secret' >&2; return 1;; esac
  if [ -n "$panel" ]; then printf '%s' "$panel"; elif [ -n "$existing" ]; then printf '%s' "$existing"; elif [ "$mode" = embedded ]; then NewRandomSecret; else echo 'Remote Registry mode requires an explicit or previously saved shared secret' >&2; return 1; fi
}

ParsePort() { local value="$1" name="$2"; [[ "$value" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( value >= 1 && value <= 65535 )) || { echo "$name must be from 1 through 65535" >&2; return 1; }; printf '%s' "$value"; }
ParseBool() { local value="${1,,}" name="$2"; case "$value" in true|false) printf '%s' "$value";; *) echo "$name must be true or false" >&2; return 1;; esac; }
TomlArray() { local value="$1" result="" raw; IFS=',' read -ra values <<< "$value"; for raw in "${values[@]}"; do [ -z "$raw" ] && continue; result="${result:+$result, }$(TomlQuote "$raw")"; done; printf '[%s]' "$result"; }

WriteAtomic() {
  local path="$1" content="$2" directory temporary
  directory="$(dirname "$path")"; mkdir -p "$directory"
  temporary="$directory/.$(basename "$path").$$.$RANDOM.tmp"
  trap 'rm -f "$temporary"' RETURN
  printf '%s' "$content" > "$temporary"
  mv -f "$temporary" "$path"
  trap - RETURN
}

ParseBackendMap
try_ids="$(ParseIdList "${NP_TRY:-hub}" false)"
whitelist_ids="$(ParseIdList "${NP_WHITELIST_SERVERS:-}" true)"
mode="${NP_REGISTRY_MODE:-embedded}"; mode="${mode,,}"
[[ "$mode" = embedded || "$mode" = remote ]] || { echo 'Registry mode must be embedded or remote' >&2; exit 1; }
access="${NP_REGISTRY_ACCESS:-same-host}"; access="${access,,}"
[[ "$access" = same-host || "$access" = other-hosts ]] || { echo 'Registry access must be same-host or other-hosts' >&2; exit 1; }
registry_url="${NP_REGISTRY_URL:-}"
if [ "$mode" = remote ] && [[ ! "$registry_url" =~ ^https?://[^[:space:]]+$ ]]; then echo 'Remote Registry mode requires an HTTP or HTTPS URL' >&2; exit 1; fi
existing="$(ReadExistingSecret "$target" "$mode")"
secret="$(ResolveSecret "${NP_SHARED_SECRET:-}" "$existing" "$mode")"
server_port="$(ParsePort "${NP_SERVER_PORT:-42420}" 'Server port')"
registry_port="$(ParsePort "${NP_REGISTRY_PORT:-8765}" 'Registry port')"
admin_port="$(ParsePort "${NP_ADMIN_PORT:-42499}" 'Admin port')"
metrics_port="$(ParsePort "${NP_METRICS_PORT:-42500}" 'Metrics port')"
max_users="$(ParsePort "${NP_MAX_USERS:-100}" 'Player limit')"
whitelist="$(ParseBool "${NP_WHITELIST_NETWORK:-false}" 'Network whitelist')"
verbose="$(ParseBool "${NP_VERBOSE:-false}" 'Verbose logging')"
[ "$access" = same-host ] && embedded_host=127.0.0.1 || embedded_host=0.0.0.0
if [ "$mode" = embedded ]; then remote_secret=""; embedded_secret="$secret"; embedded_bind="http://${embedded_host}:${registry_port}"; registry_url=""; else remote_secret="$secret"; embedded_secret=""; embedded_bind=""; fi

content="bind = $(TomlQuote "${NP_BIND_ADDRESS:-0.0.0.0}:${server_port}")
try = $(TomlArray "$try_ids")

[servers]
${BACKEND_LINES}
[transfers]
default_mode = \"redirect\"
allow_seamless = false
require_seamless_capability = true
fallback_to_redirect_when_seamless_unavailable = true
enable_unsafe_seamless_splice = false

[admin]
bind = $(TomlQuote "127.0.0.1:${admin_port}")
secret = \"\"
enabled = true
granted_permissions = [\"*\"]

[registry]
mode = $(TomlQuote "$mode")
proxy_id = $(TomlQuote "${NP_PROXY_ID:-nimbus-proxy}")
url = $(TomlQuote "$registry_url")
shared_secret = $(TomlQuote "$remote_secret")
embedded_bind = $(TomlQuote "$embedded_bind")
embedded_shared_secret = $(TomlQuote "$embedded_secret")
backend_stale_seconds = 20
backend_drop_seconds = 120
nonce_window_seconds = 90
max_reservation_ttl_seconds = 300
fail_on_error = true
transfer_intent_poll_ms = 1000
advertise_on_master_server = false

[whitelist]
network = ${whitelist}
servers = $(TomlArray "$whitelist_ids")
fail_open_until_first_sync = false

[logging]
verbose = ${verbose}
sniff_frames = false
log_traffic_bytes = false

[metrics]
enabled = true
bind = $(TomlQuote "http://127.0.0.1:${metrics_port}")
path = \"/metrics\"
status_api = true
status_api_token = \"\"

[status]
enabled = true
name = $(TomlQuote "${NP_STATUS_NAME:-Nimbus}")
motd = $(TomlQuote "${NP_STATUS_MOTD:-Vintage Story proxy}")
game_mode = \"survival\"
password = false
server_version = \"\"
max_players = ${max_users}
query_timeout_ms = 1500

[plugins]
enabled = true
directory = \"plugins\"
disabled = []

[persistence]
persist_drain_flags = true
drain_flags_file = \"nimbus.drain-state.json\"

[advanced]
connect_timeout_ms = 5000
buffer_size = 16384
"
WriteAtomic "$target" "$content"
printf 'wrote %s\n' "$target"
